newsitem.title: QATAR: Iran's Velayati arrives in Qatar on regional tour.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Velayati arrives in Qatar on regional tour.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati arrived in Doha on Tuesday carrying an invitation for Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani to an Islamic summit in Tehran.
The Iranian minister, on a tour of 10 countries, flew in from Kuwait. He has already been to Saudi Arabia and Oman.

He is extending invitations to Moslem heads of state and government from President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani for the December meeting of the Organisation of Islamic Conference, the Moslem world's largest body.
Velayati also told Qatar's state-run news agency he would discuss bilateral ties and regional developments with his Qatari counterpart Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani.
He is trying to use the regional tour to clear some of the mistrust between Iran and its Gulf Arab neighbours and assure them that Tehran was not a potential threat, Western diplomats said.
Iran's relations are often tense with its Arab neighbours across the Gulf who have accused it of interfering in their internal affairs. Iran denies the charges.
